acceptance_criteria.criterion: synthesis-knowledge-collection.md references only global and repository scopes — no mention of project scope.
knowledge-archiver.md contains no occurrence of scope: "project" or project_slug as a routing parameter.
Both documents include guidance on origin_plan as optional provenance metadata.
The scope determination section in both documents describes repository scope as codebase-level knowledge associated with a specific repository via repository_name.

summary: Updated all persona documents to replace the `global` + `project` knowledge scope model with `global` + `repository`. Changes applied to the source partial and all three built IDE variant outputs for both the synthesis persona and the knowledge-archiver standalone persona: (1) `personas/shared/partials/synthesis-knowledge-collection.md` — scope table entry changed from `project` to `repository`; `project_slug` replaced with `repository_name`; `origin_plan` guidance added as optional provenance metadata; global scope downgrade references updated. (2) `personas/standalone/src/content/knowledge-archiver.md` and its three built variants (`claude-code/`, `deep-agents/`, `vs-code/`) — all `scope: \"project\"` references replaced with `scope: \"repository\"`; `project_slug` routing parameter replaced with `repository_name`; `origin_plan` field added with provenance guidance; Operating Philosophy section updated to say `repository-scoped` instead of `project-scoped`. (3) `personas/ledger/claude-code/9-synthesis.md`, `personas/ledger/deep-agents/9-synthesis.md`, and `personas/ledger/vs-code/9-synthesis.agent.md` — same scope, field, and guidance updates applied. Zero occurrences of `scope: \"project\"` or `project_slug` remain in the personas directory.

comments.note: The built output files (claude-code/, deep-agents/, vs-code/ variants) were updated in addition to the two source files named in the WP spec, ensuring the deployed persona variants are also consistent. No CTX update was required — persona markdown files are not tracked by context.yaml.
